en-US.description: A team of long-lived bots for DeepSeek Harness.
en-US.longDescription:
DeepSeek Bot (DS Bot) is a bot plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that turns DSH into long-lived bots. You create your own bots, then talk and work with them, with bot-to-bot messages and group chats.

The desktop app brings its own DSH, so you do not need to install DSH first. Bots can run tools, keep their own memory and files, and answer side questions while they work.
en-US.name: DS Bot
en-US.releaseNotes:
Fixed
- In the Android phone app, tapping another Bot or a group chat in the sidebar or tapping an incoming notice banner no longer closes the app, and switching chats keeps each conversation's cached messages separate. (#1405, #1427, #1444, #1436)
- In the Android phone app, opening Memory for a Bot or a group chat that has a saved summary no longer closes the app. (#1405, #1436)
- The Android APK is signed with v1 (JAR), v2 and v3 signature schemes together so OEM package installers recognize its developer certificate on first install. (#1445)
- In the phone app, chat bubbles, settled ask_user and show_view cards, inline code spacing, part dividers, multi-card docks, archived group relays, long-message notes, settings rows, Chinese translations and photo previews render cleanly. (#1442; photo preview state fix reported by @hydrogen2289 in #1447)

zh-CN.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的长期运行机器人团队。
zh-CN.longDescription:
DeepSeek Bot（DS Bot）是 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的机器人插件，把 DSH 变成长期运行的机器人。你可以创建自己的机器人并与它们对话、协作，支持机器人之间互发消息和群聊。

桌面应用自带 DSH，无需先安装 DSH。机器人可以运行工具、保存自己的记忆和文件，并在执行任务的同时回答旁路问题。
